description: List CoinGecko's coin categories (category_id + display name) — the valid slugs for coingecko_list_markets's category filter. ~800 categories; pass name_contains to filter the list locally by name (e.g. "defi", "layer 1", "gaming") with strict token matching, instead of scanning all of them. Use the returned category_id exactly when filtering markets.

name_contains.description: Local name filter — every whitespace-separated token must appear in the category display name (case-insensitive, punctuation-insensitive). Omit to return the full list.

name: coingecko_list_categories

categories.description: Matching categories (full list when no filter). Data provided by CoinGecko.

categoryId.description: Category slug — pass to coingecko_list_markets's category param (e.g. "layer-1").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the filter matched nothing — suggests browsing unfiltered.

totalCount.description: Total categories available upstream before any local filter.

title: coingecko-mcp-server: list categories
